title: Tech Note: Maintaining a Web Site with 4th Dimension

historical_commentary.text: The extracted text for this asset is corrupted at the character level (likely a subsetted PDF font with no usable ToUnicode mapping), so this summary is based only on the title, download-path naming (TN_1996_16-21_(APR), implying Technical Note 96-18), and known metadata rather than verified document content. Based on the title alone, this note described using 4th Dimension to manage and maintain the content of a web site — an idea (data-driven, database-backed web content management) that remains generically relevant in spirit, though any specific 1996-era mechanism it described (most likely CGI-based, given the era's tooling landscape covered by companion notes like TN 96-11) would be entirely superseded by 4D's later built-in web server and Internet Commands, and by modern content-management approaches generally.
related_updates: 4D gained a built-in web server and 4D Internet Commands plugin around 1997-1998, superseding the third-party/CGI-based web site maintenance techniques this note likely described
Modern web content management is handled by dedicated CMS platforms or application frameworks rather than bespoke database-driven page generation of the kind implied by this note's title and era
